title: hive daemon queue output (v1)
description: Stable contract emitted by `hive daemon queue [list|show|prune] --json`. Read-only inspection of the file-backed dispatch-request queue the bot writes and the daemon consumes. `list` returns all pending requests; `show <id>` returns one; `prune` removes expired/malformed files and reports the count. ok=false (exit 1) when `show` cannot find the requested id.

ErrorPayload.description: Emitted under --json when the queue command itself fails (bad action, invalid argv shape, missing id, internal error). Distinct from the SuccessPayload ok:false 'show found nothing' result, which carries no error_kind.

action.description: The attempted action (may be an invalid value for unknown_action, or null).

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp the request was written.

age_sec.description: Seconds since created_at, at command-run time.

verb.description: argv[1] — the hive verb the daemon would spawn.

expired.description: True when created_at is older than the queue expiry window.

allowlisted.description: True when argv passes the daemon's verb allowlist + slug guard.

ok.description: True for list/prune always; for show, false when the request_id was not found.

requests.description: Pending requests (list), the pruned-expired set (prune). Absent on show.

request.description: The single request (show). Null when ok=false.

request_id.description: Echo of the requested id when show fails to find it.
